text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On our way back from an outing with Meisho 
Doto, she suddenly stopped in her tracks—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ah... A soft-serve ice cream shop...
choice_data_list: Do you want to eat it?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hyek! Um, I'm sorry! I was just a little 
curious, or rather—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Grrrumble~~)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
*yaaawn*, no, you've got it wrong~! I had 
so much fun today that it just made me 
really hungry...
choice_data_list: Shall we eat before we go?
Let's grab a bite before we go!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
N-No way, I can't~! I'll definitely drop 
it or spill it or something...
choice_data_list: You'll be fine if you eat slowly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sitting on a park bench with Meisho Doto, 
we leisurely enjoyed some soft-serve ice 
cream.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah... That soft serve was delicious. 
It was so cold, with such a gentle milky 
flavor..."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
If you hadn't said anything, Trainer, I 
definitely wouldn't have felt like 
eating...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Um, the truth is—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
When I was a kid, I loved soft-serve ice 
cream. Whenever we went out, I'd always 
beg my parents for some.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm clumsy, so I often drop them or 
end up having them eaten by goats.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Mom and Dad never got mad, but whenever I 
thought about how bad I felt, it just got 
harder and harder to ask for it...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Yet today, thanks to you, Trainer, I was 
finally able to eat it after such a long 
time...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Because you always let me pursue the 
things I'd given up on, yet still longed 
for, Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
It makes me almost fool myself into 
thinking even someone like me could do 
more things...
choice_data_list:
What other challenges do you want to take 
on?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Umm... There are other things I want 
to eat and buy, though...
choice_data_list:
Let's go eat even more street food right 
now, then!

Let's go eat even more street food right 
now, then!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Umm... There are other things I want 
to eat and buy, though...
choice_data_list:
Let's go eat even more street food right 
now, then!

Let's go eat even more street food right 
now, then!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Shopping? With you, Trainer? Ugh... 
but...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'm not bothering you, am I...? Like, 
being tired from our outing or anything...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'd like a mug. Preferably a cute, round 
one. But—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I was terrified I'd be clumsy and break 
something in the store, so I couldn't go 
shopping alone...
choice_data_list: Don't worry, I've got your back.
Don't worry, I'll back you up.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Really? What if I get so nervous my hands 
shake and I can't even walk straight...?
choice_data_list: I'm right here beside you, so lean on me

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Thank you so much... I promise I'll 
see this through to the end...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps thanks to her newfound peace of 
mind, Meisho Doto managed to finish her 
shopping without any further incident.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Um, I'm really not used to eating 
while walking around... I feel like I'm 
gonna mess up...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Still... if it's with you, Trainer-san, 
I'm sure it'd be fun... Maybe I'd like to 
try it...?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Freshly fried minced meat cutlets... are 
so delicious, aren't they? The juices just 
burst out... and get all over your hands 
and clothes, making them sticky... Ugh...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"I'm bad at eating... I always end up 
burning the inside of my mouth..."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Should I eat it from the head, or from the 
tail... Facebook-level dilemma...!?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
*yaaawn*! I-Is it really okay~? I'm a 
little scared, but... Still, um, um...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Alongside an uncharacteristically excited 
Meisho Doto, I enjoyed the shopping 
district's gourmet food to my heart's 
content.
